passive.name: New Destiny
passive.text: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

spells.name: End of the Line
spells.text: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.

spells.name: Smoke Screen
spells.text: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.

spells.name: Quickdraw
spells.text: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.

spells.name: Collateral Damage
spells.text: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.

damage.value: Graves deals magic damage with Smoke Screen’s initial impact and burst damage with Collateral Damage’s heavy shell and explosion.

spikes.at: End of the Line’s cooldown reaches 6 seconds
spikes.why: Graves can fire its explosive shell more often than when its cooldown is 13 seconds.

mistakes.value: Graves wastes shotgun bullets by firing at a target behind another unit, since the bullets cannot pass through units.
